mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 2% over 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and real final sales (RSAFS) are stagnant (growth < 1% YoY), it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS growth < 1% YoY
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS growth < 1% YoY, and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) show negative growth, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 5% and PAYEMS shows negative growth, and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances.
